notes: Registration input, not a run input: Kalshi's trade API v2 HISTORY (the kalshi_history pack, ADR-0236, named by import path; no credential) for the same six crypto series as source-kalshi-crypto.json. Stream used here: markets, 17 fields = the kalshi pack's 14 plus expiration_value (the REALISED SETTLEMENT VALUE: the CF Benchmarks RTI 60-second average, the same on every strike of an event; a float, null until settled), settlement_ts (ISO text, empty until settled) and volume (the market's whole-life contracts). statuses ['settled'] reads the settled markets from BOTH archives, the live listing and /historical/markets, routed by the cutoff the venue serves (GET /historical/cutoff: 2026-08-07 when probed 2026-10-07; nothing here types it), so history reaches back past the live API's. THE LABEL IS KNOWN ONLY AT SETTLEMENT: a row is dated at its close_time, but result and expiration_value exist only from settlement_ts, minutes later (probe: KXBTCD-26AUG0619-T73299.99 closed 23:00:00Z, settled 23:02:52Z at 64302.06). Gate a join on settlement_ts, never on the row's effective date; the value is a label (or an input to a LATER market once its settlement_ts has passed), never a feature of the market it settles. volume is the whole-life total, known only after the end: not a feature at a decision. Never use a settled market's yes_bid, yes_ask or last_price as a feature (post-settlement values). Each pull re-reads every market of the six series (a full re-pull, key ticker; the platform dedups), at limit 1000 a page: the first pull IS the measurement of how big the archive is, so read its census (runbook section 7) before choosing the candle and trade pulls, whose cost is per market. pace_s 0.25 and retries 6 as in source-kalshi-crypto.json: a failed pull commits nothing. Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source kalshi-history-crypto --catalog-source kalshi-history-crypto --connector dskit.onboarding.libs.kalshi_history:KalshiHistoryConnector --config @configs/source-kalshi-history-crypto.json --activate --root <store root>; then acquire --source kalshi-history-crypto --stream markets --mode backfill; validate with configs/suite-kalshi-history-markets.json.
